aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact recorded-counter inventory, no clock comparison or statistical effect; repeatability is gated by the required R06 regression replay.

positive.not_applicable_reason: No general matrix-existence or factor detector claim is tested. A planted matrix-positive arm would be required for such a claim. The reference is a required full-path regression control against exact observed counts; absence of a matrix here licenses no universal negative.

negative.not_applicable_reason: No population or unusual-curve claim. Both inputs are exact saved states of the same integer and polynomial.

stopping_rules.rule: One reference followed by one candidate, then stop. No new sieving, linear algebra, paid host or extra allocation.
Stop on reference mismatch, nonzero exit, missing completion, timeout, interruption, source mutation or output cap; preserve every attempt.

invalidation_rules: A failed reference blocks candidate interpretation.
Unknown controller outcome and incomplete filtering are incomplete executions, not mathematical negatives.
All clocks descriptive and wall_valid false; an interrupted run cannot resume as the same measurement.

decision_rule.text: Report completed_insufficient only with complete reconciled counters and an explicit native request for more. Report matrix_prerequisites_need_review only with the completed native return and retained prerequisite files, pending second review. Otherwise incomplete_execution. Never infer rank or a factor.
decision_rule.threshold: Exact reference counter match and complete candidate inventory; no survivor-count threshold is substituted for native filtering.
decision_rule.statistic: Per-run exact native integer counts and controller status.
decision_rule.interval: none; exact counter inventory, no inferential interval
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Raw native counts only; no speedup or hypothesis-test effect size.

graphs: Raw, unique and singleton counts per checkpoint, with matrix status separately stated.

inadmissible: Calling raw lines independent relations or a completion percentage.
Applying R07 survival fractions to R08 before filtering.
Changing budgets, seeds, input checkpoints or filter criteria after observing candidate results.
Treating file existence or singleton count as a rank proof.
Interpreting incomplete execution as a negative security result.
Claiming R08 collection or R07 filtering was preregistered by this later protocol.

literature.claim: Native filter stages and controller state transition; source files inspected locally at this pin.
Prior exact regression counts and native interval; not an unobserved experiment arm.
Canonical protocol, export, restore and second-reader contracts.
